messages:
maria: quick ping — opened PR #789 to add async/streaming support to the Python unified client + toolcall plumbing. Can someone take a quick pass when you have a minute? https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/789

maria: usage example in the PR: `async with Client() as c:
    async for chunk in c.stream_toolcall(...):
        print(chunk)` — tests + docs included but want eyes on API shape and any perf regressions.

todd: grabbing it now. will skim for breaking surface changes first.

sam: can you add a small test that asserts the iterator yields at least one chunk and closes the session? saw a race in a previous streaming test that silently swallowed errors.

maria: good call — I'll add that unit and a short integration that runs against the local mock server.

ben: quick nit on naming: `stream_toolcall` feels a bit verbose compared to `toolcall_stream` used elsewhere. not a blocker but would be nice to be consistent across clients.

maria: ok I'll rename to `toolcall_stream` in the client API and keep the shim for back-compat. will push shortly.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline started for branch `feat/py-async-unified` (build 876).

ben: also please add a changelog blurb under "clients/python" so release notes surface this.

todd: code looks fine overall. two small suggestions: 1) add an explicit `timeout` param default for the iterator, 2) update the streaming docs to call out KV cache behavior for toolcall responses.

sam: left a suggestion on the test to await the iterator close to ensure no background task leak.

maria: pushed changes — renamed API, added tests, updated docs, added changelog. kicked new CI.

deploy-bot: CI build 877 succeeded.

todd: running the quick perf smoke locally — no obvious regression on small payloads. LGTM from my side once sam is happy with the test.

sam: test looks stable now. approved. :thumbsup:

ben: approved, thanks for addressing comments.

maria: thanks all — merging in ~10m. I'll cut a patch release and roll to staging first, will monitor latency and error rates. tagging @eng-oncall in case the canary spikes.

maria: merge done. release v0.14.3 created and staging rollout started. will report back in #eng-runtime if anything odd shows up.

todd: nice work!

ben: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Staging rollout initiated for v0.14.3 (canary 5%).
